data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for forward and reverse geocoding using platform services.
data.what_it_does: Provides methods to convert coordinates to addresses and addresses to coordinates. Wraps native iOS, macOS, and Android geocoding APIs behind a simple Dart API.
use_when: You need to obtain human‑readable addresses from lat/long values
You need to convert user‑entered addresses into geographic coordinates
avoid_when: You require offline geocoding or custom data sources
You need high‑volume batch geocoding beyond platform rate limits
strengths: Uses native platform geocoding services (no extra API keys)
Simple API with single Geocoding class
weaknesses: Relies on platform rate limits and network availability
No support for Windows, Linux, or web
Limited to free built‑in services, no advanced features
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec.yaml; no additional native configuration beyond default platform permissions for location services.

alternatives.name: geolocator
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides location tracking and also basic geocoding with more control over permissions

alternatives.name: flutter_map
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need full map UI integration alongside geocoding
